verdict.rationale: Composio's docs describe automated OAuth via Connect Links and per-user credential storage with automatic refresh (composio-docs-6, composio-docs-20, composio-docs-27), but there's no explicit documentation of encryption-at-rest for the vault, and an independent security report found a leaked Composio API key exposed live Gmail, GitHub and CircleCI tokens, showing the credential vault did not protect tokens as claimed in practice (composio-comm-2). missing for 10: explicit encryption-at-rest documentation, security audit/certification, and resolution/mitigation evidence for the leaked-key incident.
